title: agoseris gracilens var. greenei
intro: Agoseris gracilens var. greenei, commonly known as Greene's dune sunflower, is a rare and endemic plant species found in the coastal dunes of California in the United States. The plant has been traditionally used by Native Americans for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The health benefits of Greene's dune sunflower include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal effects.
